subject: size of median line in boxplot

messages.author: 4fdc04b06b76c8cf
messages.subject: size of median line in boxplot
parts:
Hello,

in my boxplots the lines for the median
are slightly thicker than the lines for
the rest of the boxplot (boxes and wiskers).
Is that a general behaviour, because on
http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_boxplot.html there
is not such a behaviour?

How can I change that thickness so that it is the
same for box and median. I use theme_bw but it
is no difference between normal mode and theme_bw.

Thank you very much,

best regards,
Johannes

Do you have a reproducible example of the behavior? 

The boxplot in your previous email shows up normal as far as I can (with the exception of the abline). 

Last time I wanted to change the default boxplot appearance it involved hacking geom_boxplot, so unless you've been playing with it I don't see how you've got a thicker line unless you've found a very peculiar bug. 


Brandon

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: size of median line in boxplot
parts:
There's a new argument, 'fatten', that controls the thickness of the median line (relative to the box lines). You probably want to use something like:
  geom_boxplot(fatten=1)

-Winston
